tasks.name: Confirm libmp4 codec detection call site
tasks.notes: Confirmed: mp4_demux_get_track_video_decoder_config() at Mp4ReaderSource.cpp:1362 (readSPSPPS). vdc->codec can be checked against MP4_VIDEO_CODEC_HEVC (libmp4.h:91). tasks.name: Add headers and pin member
tasks.notes: Added #include H265Metadata.h and H265Utils.h to Mp4ReaderSource.cpp. Added h265ImagePinId to Mp4ReaderDetailAbs base class. Added h265ImagePinId to Mp4ReaderSource private members. Added Mp4ReaderDetailH265 forward declaration to header.

tasks.name: Implement Mp4ReaderDetailH265 class
tasks.notes: Added Mp4ReaderDetailH265 class declaration and full implementation. readVpsSpsPps() reads hevc.vps/sps/pps from libmp4 vdc struct, builds 12-byte-header VPS+SPS+PPS NAL buffer. prependVpsSpsPps() prepends VPS+SPS+PPS before IDR frames. produceFrames() uses H265Utils::getNALUType/isIDR. mp4Seek/getGop/sendEndOfStream mirror H264. mH265Metadata added to base class.

tasks.name: Auto-detect codec in init(), update addOutPutPin()/validateOutputPins()
tasks.notes: Added HEVC_DATA branch in init() to instantiate Mp4ReaderDetailH265 and assign h265ImagePinId. Added HEVC_DATA branch in addOutPutPin(). Added HEVC_DATA to validateOutputPins() whitelist. Commits: fecf4eb, be83609, 7fdcf3f.
